SELECT e.*,fou.unit_id,fe.employee_id,fop.position_id FROM ( SELECT t.employee_assign_id, t1.employee_code, t1. NAME, ( SELECT fop.position_code FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = t.position_id ) position_code, ( SELECT fop.position_name FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = t.position_id ) position_name, ( SELECT fou.unit_code FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = t.unit_id ) unit_code, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = t.unit_id ) unit_name, fc.company_code, fc.company_full_name, fc.company_id FROM fnd_employee t1, fnd_employee_assigns t, FND_COMPANY fc WHERE t.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND t1.employee_id = t.employee_id AND fc.company_id = t1.company_id AND fc.company_id = t.company_id
) e,fnd_org_unit fou,fnd_employee fe,FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE e.company_id = fou.company_id and e.unit_code = fou.unit_code and fe.employee_code = e.employee_code and fe.company_id = e.company_id and fop.position_code = e.position_code and fop.unit_id = fou.unit_id order by e.employee_code

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT tab.*, sua.role_id,sua.company_id, (select fc.company_full_name from FND_COMPANY fc where sua.company_id=fc.company_id )company_full_name, ( SELECT srb.ROLE_CODE FROM sys_role_b srb WHERE srb.ROLE_ID = sua.role_id ) ROLE_CODE, ( SELECT srb.ROLE_NAME FROM sys_role_b srb WHERE srb.ROLE_ID = sua.role_id ) ROLE_NAME, sua.allocation_id, sua.enabled_flag, sua.user_id, sysdate as "sysdate" FROM ( SELECT t.employee_id, t.employee_assign_id, t1.employee_code, t1. NAME, t.position_id, t1.email, ( SELECT fop.position_code FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = t.position_id ) position_code, ( SELECT fop.position_name FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = t.position_id ) position_name, t.unit_id, ( SELECT fou.unit_code FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = t.unit_id ) unit_code, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = t.unit_id ) unit_name, fc.company_code, -- fc.company_full_name, fc.company_short_name FROM fnd_employee_assigns t, fnd_employee t1, FND_COMPANY fc WHERE t.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND t1.employee_id = t.employee_id AND fc.company_id = t.company_id
) tab right JOIN (SELECT * FROM sys_user_allocation sa WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_b sr WHERE sr.ROLE_ID = sa.role_id AND nvl( sr.END_ACTIVE_DATE, to_date('2099-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) > sysdate AND nvl( sr.START_ACTIVE_DATE, to_date('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) < sysdate)) sua ON sua.employee_assign_id = tab.employee_assign_id )tab2 where ((tab2.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and #{allocationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} is null) or tab2.allocation_id= #{allocationId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
select su.user_name from sys_user su,sys_user_allocation sua where su.user_id = sua.user_id and sua.allocation_id = #{allocationId}

select sua.user_id from sys_user_allocation sua where 1=1
and sua.allocation_id = #{allocationId}

SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, sys_role_b srb, sys_user su, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fe WHERE srb.role_code = 'ADMIN' AND srb.role_id = sua.role_id AND sua.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND su.user_id = sua.user_id AND fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id AND fea.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fe.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND sua.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT t.employee_id, t.employee_assign_id, t1.employee_code, t1. NAME, t.position_id, t1.email, s.user_id, s.role_id, ( SELECT fop.position_code FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = t.position_id ) position_code, ( SELECT fop.position_name FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = t.position_id ) position_name, t.unit_id, ( SELECT fou.unit_code FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = t.unit_id ) unit_code, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = t.unit_id ) unit_name FROM fnd_employee_assigns t, sys_user_allocation s, fnd_employee t1 WHERE t.employee_assign_id = s.employee_assign_id AND t1.employee_id = t.employee_id AND s.allocation_id = #{allocationId} AND t.enabled_flag = 'Y'
